The '''fastcutter''' was a common brand of [[vibro-cutter]] manufactured by [[Craftsbeing]]. It measured 0.3 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] and was a heavy cutting tool equipped with an [[Ultrasonic generator/Legends|ultrasonic generator]] which caused a vibration that enabled it to cut with the slightest touch. Like other vibro-cutters, the Fastcutter was designed with industrial uses in mind, but this did not prevent it from being used as a weapon.
